score_of_record: Mean 95% interval score (Gneiting-Raftery) in log range over all sigma = 1 deg G5 rows, a row without a usable covariance charged the 99th percentile (eval.calibration).
carried_rule: Of the head's three seeds (cal-s1..cal-s3, best epoch), the carried head is the one with the median validation interval score in log range (seed 314 scoring ordinals 500-1499; tma2-g3 on the validation scoring run's errors.npz).
shuffled_rule: The shuffled head (cal-shuffled) is scored on validation at its best and at its last epoch. If either one's interval score in log range minus the temperature's (paired, clustered, 97.5%) lies wholly below zero, a G3-c pass is void (recorded as not passed). The test gate reads the outcome from validation.json by the digest in carried.json.
validation_rule: The carried head goes to test only if every check's point meets its band or limit on validation (G3-a, G3-b inside [0.92, 0.98]; G3-c below 0; G3-d exact). Otherwise seed 320 is not generated and the record says so; the follow-on is decided as SRD section 5.
follow_on: SRD section 5: proposed in the write-up with a recommended default, adopted if the owner has not objected by the next spec. If only G3-c fails, the temperature is carried as the calibration. If G3-a or G3-b fails, the expected default is a heavy-tailed predictive (Student-t or a gross-error mixture) as a new spec, since E's errors are heavy-tailed.
forecast: Validation baseline: E's 95% coverage 0.60 (log range), 0.53 (course), 0.65 (speed); 0.33 of rows within the chi2_4 95% NEES point. The local temperature fitted on the tuning rows (0-499, in sample) reaches 0.965 / 0.926 / 0.960 coverage (log range / course / speed) but only 0.79 of rows within the NEES point. Forecast: G3-a pass 0.4 (course the binding quantity), G3-b pass 0.15 (heavy joint tails), G3-c pass 0.5 (the head reads range and E's state, which the temperature cannot), G3-d pass 1.0 (points are copied). Overall pass about 0.1; the most likely outcome is G3-b failed on validation, so seed 320 is not generated.
